R0102.title: Boosting (Carry Service)
R0102.definition: A player (the 'boss') joins a team with a cheater and teams up with the cheating player to gain rapid in-game benefits.
R0102.description: In different games, this practice has different names such as 'riding the hack train' or 'taking a flight'. Boosting via cheaters now has a mature commercial model with clear division of labor among cheat distributors, black market intermediaries, and cheat users.
R0102.influence: Affects game fairness and other players' experience.

observables: Low-rank accounts consistently team up and match with high-rank cheating accounts
Boss accounts show an anomalous win-rate surge while their own gameplay metrics are clearly below the rank level
A cheating carry account in the team provides the majority of damage output
Team members show linked IPs/devices, suggesting the same cheat gang
After boosting, the boss account's rank and record jump without a corresponding improvement in gameplay data
